claim: Differentially verified subset of Optuna 4.9.0; not a drop-in replacement for the complete Python package.

oracle.seed_rule: Every seeded comparison uses the same explicit seed, options, parameter order, history, and sequential ask/tell order.

complete_api_closure.rule: A complete-compatibility claim is forbidden until every inventoried public symbol and class member is present and has an exact upstream-oracle mapping.

shared_behavior_verified: Study ask/tell-by-object/tell-by-number/enqueue/add-trial lifecycle, including imported WAITING/RUNNING trials, finished-trial handling, directions, metric names, attributes, FrozenTrial-returning get_trials/best_trial/best_trials observables, and single-MAT-storage load/copy/delete/list management
StudySummary objects, include_best_trial behavior, single- versus multi-objective direction access, and immediate registration of empty stored studies
BaseTrial inheritance for Trial, FixedTrial, and FrozenTrial; BaseSampler/BasePruner subtype identity; and the BasePruner.prune interface
TrialPruned exception handling through Study.optimize, including PRUNED state, last intermediate value, and callback snapshot
FixedTrial objective evaluation, suggestions, attributes, warnings, and incompatibility errors
FrozenTrial suggestions, no-op report, should-prune result, mutable attributes, collection return types, and incompatibility errors
Float, integer, stepped, logarithmic, and categorical distributions, including effective-high adjustment, repeated-parameter compatibility, and arbitrary parameter names
Distribution JSON round trips, dynamic-space compatibility checks, and the five deprecated Optuna 4.9 distribution aliases
StudyDirection and TrialState values, TrialState.is_finished, enum inputs to study/trial factories, and Study.direction
IntersectionSearchSpace and intersection_search_space, including pruned-state inclusion, ignored failed/waiting trials, sorted keys, dynamic-range exclusion, and retained single-value distributions

Sampler seed=None constructor semantics: independently constructed unseeded samplers draw fresh private entropy without mutating MATLAB's global RNG; exact proposal comparison remains explicitly seeded
RandomSampler proposal sequences
TPESampler scalar, mixed, multivariate, group-decomposed conditional, constrained, callable gamma/weights, and categorical-distance proposal sequences, including independent-fallback warning control
MOTPESampler multi-objective proposal sequences and constrained Pareto support
GridSampler and fixed/conditional BruteForceSampler exhaustion behavior
PartialFixedSampler proposal sequences

QMCSampler seeded scrambled and deterministic unscrambled Sobol/Halton prefixes within the documented dimension boundary, custom independent samplers, and warning controls for seed=None scrambling and independent fallback
CmaEsSampler seeded numeric proposal sequences and independent-sampler controls
GPSampler float/integer/categorical proposals through acquisition after startup, constraint-aware acquisition, and deterministic MAT-table history replay when Backend is upstream-python
NSGAIISampler and NSGAIIISampler seeded population behavior
NSGA-II Uniform, BLX-alpha, SBX, VSBX, SPX, and UNDX crossover proposal sequences
Percentile, threshold, patient, no-op, successive-halving, Hyperband, and Wilcoxon pruning decisions
fANOVA parameter importance through the pinned Optuna 4.9.0 evaluator
MaxTrialsCallback, BestValueStagnationEvaluator, and stagnation-based Terminator behavior
Official Optuna MCP Study/Trial tool contract where optuna-mcp exposes the operation
matlab_integration_only: parallel trial scheduling, overshoot, late completion, and deterministic cache handling
MATLAB table normalization and MAT-file persistence/reload
MATLAB callback transactions and storage locking
Simulink block, mask, signal, and run-artifact integration
native MEX kernel lifecycle and fallback selection
GPSampler Backend=matlab-native state persistence and lifecycle

unsupported_or_not_yet_oracled.feature: Remaining TPE constructor and concurrent-trial behavior
unsupported_or_not_yet_oracled.boundary: The deprecated consider_prior argument and its warning category, plus constant-liar behavior with genuinely concurrent running trials, are not yet upstream-oracled. Group-decomposed multivariate TPE, categorical-distance callbacks, independent-fallback warning control, and callable gamma/weights are covered.

Warm start from source trials, separable CMA, margin, learning-rate adaptation, restart strategies, and native categorical handling are not claimed. A separately seeded independent sampler and its warning control are covered.
The MATLAB-native Sobol direction table is limited to 32 dimensions; use the SciPy-backed path where supported or treat higher dimensions as unsupported.
RDB/Journal storage, heartbeat and stale-trial recovery, artifact stores, visualization/dashboard, and third-party integrations are not implemented by the MATLAB layer.

Public logging, storage classes, group-decomposed search-space helpers, visualization functions, artifact APIs, integrations, and Python plugin extension points are outside the current MATLAB subset. Compatibility claims apply only to entries listed in shared_behavior_verified.
